# Java Audiveris 5.11 (Temurin JDK 25.0.3+9 LTS) STEMS beam-stump oracle.
#
# Every page starts in a fresh Epsilon-GC JVM and reaches real HEADS.
# The probe then constructs every BeamLinker in stable x order, exactly as
# StemsRetriever.inspectStems does before tremolo removal or head linking.
#
# Rows freeze neighboring seed order, parallelogram intersection, stable cross-x
# sort, every duplicate-purge comparison, beam-side classification, and both
# horizontal sides. Each side build freezes full VLAG intersection/source order,
# stable area-center distance order, every width/break compound step, fixed glyph
# raster, sibling extrema and exact dy direction evidence, registration/reuse,
# canonical aliases, final stump/side lists, and looksLikeTremolo.
#
# pre:N, reg:N, kept:N, source section ordinals, and sig ordinals are local
# deterministic boundary ordinals, never Java IDs or identity hash codes.
# Doubles include hex text/raw bits. FNV-1a-64 covers semantic rows; the runner
# appends SHA-256 commitments for the source and emitted body.
